name: Truncated Tensor Decomposition
definition: A rank-reduced approximation where the multilinear rank $(R_1, R_2, ..., R_N)$ is explicitly chosen to be smaller than the initial ranks $(I_1, I_2, ..., I_N)$ to achieve compression.
summary: Truncated Tensor Decomposition compresses volume data by selectively discarding negligible principal components from an existing Tucker decomposition, leveraging core orthogonality for efficient, progressive quality adjustment without recomputation.
